gain_rule: clip(median(latest observed EPSS per training CVE), 0.001, 0.05)
selection: Earliest strictly best validation MAE from epoch 1; epoch zero excluded
limitations: This task differs from R07 in anchor, target and cohort; headline scores are not a paired comparison with R07.
Validation informed earlier development; it is not an independent final evaluation.
Missing inputs remain masked; observed Day-90 targets are never imputed.
Stored daily EPSS does not establish exact release time within each date.
Longer history may add missing days rather than new observations.
Source masks support later retrospective TPG fusion, not authenticated historical text.
All seeds must be reported; smoke performance does not select settings.
